diferenciais.subtitulo: A complete experience based on practice, structure, and real immersion.

itens.descricao: From beginner to advanced. Seven books designed to deliver real progress, from placement to complex debates.
Conversation from the beginning, gradually increasing from 50% to classes that are almost fully in English.
Stories, songs, and grammar structures focused on real everyday conversation.
Discussions about complex and current topics, developing argumentation and advanced vocabulary.

livros.descricao: Ensures every student starts with the same foundation. Essential verbs, simple commands, and preparation for English classes.
Introduction to listening and conversation. Everyday sentences and natural basic communication.
Children's stories and songs. 60 minutes of conversation plus 20 minutes of grammar. Correct and systematic pronunciation.
Free conversation. Complex vocabulary, 65-70 minutes of conversation plus 10 minutes of grammar. Preparation for debates.
Debates on complex topics such as abortion, age of criminal responsibility, capitalism vs. socialism, and euthanasia.
Deeper debate practice. Supporting complex opinions and expanding advanced vocabulary.
Consolidated fluency. Practical projects involving companies, NGOs, campaigns, and professional presentations.

eventos.titulo: Events to Practice English in Real Life

itens.descricao: Every last Sunday of the month, from 1:00 PM to 5:30 PM. A meeting for students from the middle of module 2 onward, with interactive games and guided activities that turn vocabulary into real conversation.
Hopi Hari, Taquaral, museums, cultural events, and more. We live real experiences where English is the only language allowed. Full immersion in practice.

paragrafos: My name is Jefferson and I am 34 years old. I built an 11-year career at IBM Brazil using, in practice, all the languages I teach.

With degrees in Business Administration and Geography, I am passionate about learning. At 17, already fluent in English and Spanish, I started looking for new challenges. Today, I speak six languages at fluent or advanced levels.
I currently lead more than 20 groups and bring my international corporate experience into a proprietary methodology focused on real results.
